summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmod+x's it in a temp directory, then uses that Bun binary to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript file using rotating string-array obfuscation (identifiers like `MmgoCP`/`etDiOOB`/`JqTtnbZ`, opaque numeric constant tables, hex-mangled function names `_0xNNNN`). Neither `setup.mjs` nor `math_init.js` is declared in `package.json`'s `files: ["lib"]` allowlist — they were smuggled into the tarball outside the declared publish surface. The package's stated purpose is an Apollo GraphQL timeout link (upstream drcallaway/apollo-link-timeout) which does not require Bun or a 700KB payload. Fetching a secondary runtime at install to execute an out-of-manifest obfuscated blob unrelated to the library's advertised function matches the shape of a compromised republish under the @ornikar scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
